meta.name: give-me-tips
meta.description: Explains any senpi tip in depth, including Tip: lines in the TUI. Use when the user asks about a tip, what a tipped feature does, or which tips they can see.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把界面上看不懂的功能提示讲清楚
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果软件界面里冒出提示,你想弄清它到底在说什么。
copy.tagline_en: Explain any in-app feature tip so you know what it does
copy.fit_line_en: For you if a tip pops up in the interface and you want to know what it means.

howto.what: 当你问起某条 senpi 提示时,它会先跑 `senpi --list-tips` 取实时列表,再读你的 settings.json 判断你本人能看到哪些提示,然后查源码核实,用你提问的语言讲清这条提示背后的真实机制,并给出读过的文件路径。
howto.when: 当你问起某条提示是什么意思、某个被提示的功能怎么工作,或是你自己能看到哪些提示时,它会接手。

say.text: 刚才那行 Tip: 是什么意思?
say.note: 它会查实时提示列表和源码后解释。

say.text: 这条提示背后的功能是怎么实现的?
say.note: 会引用具体文件路径说明机制。

say.text: 我自己能看到哪些提示?
say.note: 它会读你的 settings.json 说明原因。

howto.what_en: When you ask about a senpi tip, it runs `senpi --list-tips`, reads your settings.json to see which tips you can actually see, checks the source, then explains the tip's real mechanism in your language and cites file paths.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask what a tip means, how a tipped feature works, or which tips you can see.

say_en.text: What did that Tip: line mean?
say_en.note: It checks the live tip list and source, then explains.

say_en.text: How does the feature behind this tip work?
say_en.note: It cites concrete file paths for the mechanism.

say_en.text: Which tips can I actually see?
say_en.note: It reads your settings.json to say why.
